requirements.requirement: Configure Nginx on the RHEL 8.8 node1 system to listen on TCP port 6700.
requirements.summary: Node1 is confirmed as RHEL 8.8. The Nginx configuration passed validation, the service was active, and direct socket observations showed Nginx listening on port 6700 over IPv4 and IPv6.

requirements.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700.
requirements.summary: A request to http://10.100.42.10:6700/ returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with an Nginx-served response body.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied: Nginx is operational on node1 at TCP port 6700, and / returns HTTP 200. The only notable hygiene issue is the unnecessary additional port-80 listener.
limitations: The HTTP request originated on node1 using its managed-node address rather than from an independent remote client.

operational_hygiene.summary: No failed services or package-health problems were observed. However, enabling the stock Nginx configuration also introduced wildcard IPv4 and IPv6 listeners on TCP port 80, an additional exposure not required by the task. The added systemd-private temporary paths are normal runtime state.
